jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibility:**

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science engineering. Overall 5\+ years of experience in AI ML roles
* Experience in implementing real projects using Gen AI, Fine tuning LLMs , RAG.
* Experience in implementing enterprise level Agentic solution using any of the open frameworks (Langgraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, etc.)
* Experience with vector databases / embeddings
* Experience in Document AI / OCR / extraction solutions and structured output creation
* Understanding of Both Opensource and Open AI LLMs and RAG architecture
* Exposure implementing multiple machine learning and AI techniques such as supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning, Deep learning, NLP
* Familiarity with NLP literature, thrust areas, conference venues, and code repositories
* Familiarity with UI tools like Streamlit, flask etc , FAST APIs , Rest APIs , Docker containers
* Proficiency in Python, pytorch , SQL and other programming languages for data analysis and modeling with atleast 5\+ years of experience.
* Proficiency in libraries such as OpenAI API
* Proficiency with cloud development environments such as Azure, AWS, and GCP
* Proven good grasp of using LLMs, Deploying LLMs
* Proven excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: ML Engineer II
jobs.description:
**Role description**  

We are looking for senior, autonomous software engineers to build AI\-powered product features for a Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, AI systems, and scalable cloud architecture. You will design, build, and evolve AI\-based capabilities such as: Real\-time and post\-call transcription services LLM\- features (summarization, agent assist, analytics, automation) Prompt management and orchestration Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines Knowledge base ingestion and management AI\-driven workflows embedded directly into CCaaS user experiences You are expected to deeply understand product requirements, make technical decisions independently, and contribute end\-to\-end from architecture and backend services to frontend experiences. What You ll Do AI\-Centric Product Development Design and implement AI\-based product features for CCaaS use cases Integrate LLM services, transcription engines, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG pipelines Design prompt strategies, prompt versioning, and evaluation mechanisms for reliable AI behavior. Build systems that safely and efficiently interact with external AI providers (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS, etc.). Architecture \& Scalability Design scalable, modular, and observable AI architectures suitable for real\-time and high\-volume CCaaS workloads. Apply best practices for event\-driven, asynchronous, and distributed systems. Ensure AI systems are cost\-aware, fault\-tolerant, and designed for continuous evolution. Collaborate on decisions around data flow, latency, throughput, and reliability especially for real\-time voice and messaging scenarios. Full\-Stack Ownership Build and maintain backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and NestJS. Develop frontend experiences using React.js (or similar), especially for AI\-assisted workflows and real\-time UI updates. Contribute to API design, frontend\-backend contracts, and system integrations. For frontend\-leaning roles: focus on AI\-driven UX, real\-time dashboards, agent tools, and explainability of AI outputs. Product \& Team Collaboration Work closely with product managers, designers, QA, and other engineers from discovery to delivery. Translate business and product needs into clear technical designs and implementation plans. Actively challenge assumptions and propose better solutions technically and from a product perspective. Mentor peers and contribute to engineering best practices and standards. Engineering Excellence Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code. Build automated tests for business\-critical and AI\-dependent logic. Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions. Create and maintain technical documentation for both systems and AI behaviors. Continuously improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience. What You Bring Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 6 \- 8 years of professional software development experience. Strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and React.js (or equivalent frontend frameworks). Proven ability to work autonomously, owning features from concept to production. Solid understanding of loosely coupled, modular, and event\-driven architectures. Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered production features (not just experimentation). LLM concepts and limitations Prompt engineering and prompt lifecycle management RAG architectures and vector search Knowledge base ingestion and enrichment pipelines Experience integrating with AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or similar). Ability to reason about latency, accuracy, cost, and reliability trade\-offs in AI systems. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with cloud\-native architectures (AWS, Azure). Experience with message brokers / streaming platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka). Strong Git workflows and CI/CD best practices. Comfort working in Linux\-based environments. Mindset \& Soft Skills Product\-oriented mindset: you understand why you rebuilding something, not just how. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Excellent communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams (fluent English required). Willingness to challenge ideas constructively and propose alternatives. Passion for learning, experimentation, and staying current with AI and software trends. Leadership mindset whether through mentoring, technical guidance, or ownership. Additional Requirements We Consider Essential Knowledge of VoIP, real\-time communications, or contact center platforms. Experience handling real\-time or near\-real\-time data streams. Understanding of observability for distributed and AI\-driven systems. Awareness of AI governance, security, and privacy considerations, especially when handling customer conversations and data. Strong bias toward simple, maintainable solutions over over\-engineering.  



  

**Skills**  

React, Node.js, AI Governance, CCaaS

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About Pramira**


Pramira is a California\-based engineering and construction company specializing in telecommunications, electrical, and infrastructure projects. We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to join our team in India.

 **Job Description** **About the Role**


You will study how our teams work, find tasks that AI agents and automation can take over, and then build, deploy, and maintain those solutions. You will use free, open\-source, and existing Microsoft 365 tools wherever possible, running them on the cloud or on our own servers. This is a hands\-on role: you will own your solutions from idea to daily use.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review workflows with our operations, project, field, finance, and HR teams and find where AI can save time
* Build AI agents that can plan, use tools, and complete multi\-step business tasks
* Build an AI assistant that answers staff questions from our company procedures and policies (RAG)
* Automate construction tasks such as RFI drafting, document data extraction, bid screening, compliance reminders, and weekly reports
* Connect agents to Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate), Smartsheet, and other systems through APIs
* Deploy and run open\-source platforms such as n8n, LangGraph, CrewAI, and Ollama using Docker on Linux or cloud servers
* Monitor performance, fix issues, control costs, and keep sensitive data secure
* Document your work and train staff to use the tools

  

**Qualifications** **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years in software development or automation, including 1\+ year building LLM applications or AI agents
* Strong Python skills and experience with REST APIs
* Hands\-on experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or n8n)
* Experience with RAG and vector databases (Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector, or similar)
* Experience deploying applications with Docker on Linux and on at least one cloud platform
* Experience with both commercial LLM APIs and open\-source models run locally
* Good spoken and written English, and the ability to explain technical work to non\-technical staff

**Nice to Have**

* Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, or Copilot Studio experience
* Smartsheet API experience
* Experience in construction, telecom, engineering, or field services
* OCR and data extraction from PDFs, drawings, and forms
* Experience working with US\-based teams

**What We Offer**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid sick leave
* Direct work with company leadership on high\-impact projects
* Freedom to choose and build the tools that shape how the company runs

**Application Questions**

* Describe one AI agent or automation you built that people use regularly. What did it do?
* Which agent frameworks have you used in production?
* Have you run open\-source language models on your own server? Which ones?
* Can you work (X) hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time?
* What is your current and expected annual CTC, and your notice period?

  

**Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Remote Python Developer
jobs.description:
**About the Projects:** we are building LLM evaluation and training datasets to train LLM to work on realistic software engineering problems. One of our approaches, in this project, is to build verifiable SWE tasks based on public repository histories in a synthetic approach with human\-in\-the\-loop; while expanding the dataset coverage to different types of tasks in terms of programming language, difficulty level, and etc.  

**About the Role:**
We are looking for experienced software engineers (tech lead level) who are familiar with high\-quality public GitHub repositories and can contribute to this project. This role involves hands\-on software engineering work, including development environment automation, issue triaging, and evaluating test coverage and quality.  

**Why Join Us?**
Turing is one of the world’s fastest\-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. You’ll be at the forefront of evaluating how LLMs interact with real code, influencing the future of AI\-assisted software development. This is a unique opportunity to blend practical software engineering with AI research.  

**What does day\-to\-day look like:*** Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open\-source libraries.
* Set up and configure code repositories, including Dockerization and environment setup.
* Evaluating unit test coverage and quality.
* Modify and run codebases locally to assess LLM performance in bug\-fixing scenarios.
* Collaborate with researchers to design and identify repositories and issues that are challenging for LLMs.
* Opportunities to lead a team of junior engineers to collaborate on projects.

 **Required Skills:*** Minimum 3\+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience with at least one of the following languages: Python.
* Proficiency with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup.
* Ability to understand and navigate complex codebases.
* Comfortable running, modifying, and testing real\-world projects locally.
* Experience contributing to or evaluating open\-source projects is a plus.

 **Nice to Have:*** Previous participation in LLM research or evaluation projects.
* Experience building or testing developer tools or automation agents.
* Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
	+ Work in a fully remote environment.
	+ Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

 **Offer Details:*** **Commitments Required:** At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. (We have 3 options of time commitment: 20 hrs/week, 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week).
* **Employment type:** Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave).
* **Duration of contract:** 3 month; \[expected start date is next week].

 **After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.**

jobs.title: AI Engineer – GenAI & Agentic AI
jobs.description:
**About Kitron**
----------------

  

Kitron is a leading Scandinavian Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company, delivering improved flexibility, cost efficiency, and innovation power through the value chain. The company has operations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Lithuania, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, India, China, Malaysia, and the United States. With 2500 highly skilled employees, Kitron manufactures and delivers anything from fully assembled electronic circuit boards to complete end \- products for customers globally. Related technical services like prototyping, industrialisation, material analysing and test development are also key competencies offered by Kitron.

**Our values**
--------------

 **Location:** Chennai  

**Deadline:** 2026\.10\.28

### **Job Description:**

* Develop AI applications and POCs for business, operations, engineering, and manufacturing use cases.
* Build Generative AI solutions using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Phi, or similar models.
* Develop RAG solutions using company documents, databases, and enterprise knowledge.
* Design and develop AI agents and agentic workflows for multi\-step business tasks, decision\-making, and tool/API usage.
* Integrate AI solutions with REST APIs, databases, enterprise applications, and approved tools.
* Develop human\-in\-the\-loop workflows for validation, approval, and exception handling.
* Build backend services, data\-processing workflows, and supporting APIs for AI applications.
* Evaluate AI models and solutions based on accuracy, reliability, performance, cost, and security.
* Use Microsoft Azure AI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or other suitable AI platforms.
* Develop and deploy AI applications using Docker in cloud or on\-premise environments.
* Conduct technical feasibility studies, rapid prototyping, POCs, testing, and deployment.
* Collaborate with business, IT, software, engineering, and other technical teams to deliver practical AI solutions.
* Prepare solution architecture, technical documentation, and POC/evaluation reports.
* Continuously explore emerging Generative AI, Agentic AI, models, and frameworks.

### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Electronics, IT, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in AI engineering, software engineering, Generative AI, or related application development.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python and software development.
* Practical experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval.
* Experience developing AI agents, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, or multi\-step AI applications.
* Experience with frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or equivalent.
* Strong experience with REST APIs, SQL databases, and system integration.
* Experience with Git, Docker, Linux, CI/CD, and cloud or on\-premise deployment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, or Azure OpenAI is preferred.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, structured outputs, prompt engineering, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to convert business requirements into practical AI solutions.
* Good communication skills and ability to work with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to independently take an AI use case from assessment and architecture through POC, evaluation, and deployment.
* Exposure to computer vision, manufacturing, engineering, automation, or robotics is an added advantage.
* Willingness to continuously learn and experiment with emerging AI technologies.

### **We offer:**

* Global team and projects
* Opportunities for personal and professional development
* Training and competence development courses.

jobs.title: AI-Native Java Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**


Zycus is a global leader in Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation.
At the core of Zycus’ platform is **Merlin AI**, an advanced AI\-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real\-time visibility and actionable insights.
Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as **Gartner, Forrester, and IDC** for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise\-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer\-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long\-term business value.
With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI\-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement.  

  

**We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer:**
Zycus is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. All hiring decisions will be based solely on qualifications, skills, and experience relevant to the job requirements.
**Job Description**


We are seeking a Core Java Developer with strong backend engineering fundamentals and practical exposure to Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate will contribute to building scalable enterprise applications while leveraging modern AI\-assisted development and GenAI\-driven product features.
The ideal candidate will also be an **early adopter of Generative AI coding tools** like **GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Groq, ChatGPT, or similar**, and leverage them to enhance productivity, accelerate development, and maintain code quality.
### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and deploy scalable, secure, and maintainable **Java\-based backend systems** using Java (core/advanced/framework) or any other JVM technology.
* Adept in writing production quality scalable apps with coding agents like cursor, claudecode, codex etc
* Build high\-performance, multi\-threaded applications with clean architecture
* Integrate front\-end and back\-end systems, ensuring seamless data exchange and user experience.
* Work with **REST APIs**, **JWT authentication**, and **cloud\-based deployment environments** (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Use **Generative AI tools** (Cursor AI, Groq, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) to optimize coding workflows, debugging, and documentation.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (DevOps, QA, Product, UX) in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Participate in **code reviews**, **unit testing**, and **continuous integration/delivery (CI/CD)** pipelines.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices in **AI\-assisted software development**.
**Job Requirement**


### **Required Skills \& Experience**


* **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in **Java development**.
* Strong proficiency in **Spring Framework**, **Spring Boot**, and **Microservices architecture**.
* Strong expertise in Core Java and object\-oriented programming
* Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading and concurrency
* Experience with **REST APIs**, **JSON**, **JPA/Hibernate**, and **SQL/NoSQL databases**.
* Knowledge of **CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Experience working with **cloud platforms** (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Demonstrated use of **AI coding tools** such as **Cursor AI**, **GitHub Copilot**, **Groq**, **ChatGPT**, or others to automate or enhance development.
* Strong debugging and analytical skills with a focus on performance optimization.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Exposure to **Docker, Kubernetes**, and **containerized deployments**.
* Understanding of **event\-driven architectures** (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Familiarity with **Test\-Driven Development (TDD)** or **Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD)**.
* Contributions to **open\-source projects** or **AI\-assisted coding communities**.

### **Why Join Us**


* Work on **cutting\-edge applications** powered by **AI\-assisted development workflows**.
* Collaborate with a **forward\-thinking engineering team** that values innovation and continuous learning.
* Access to **premium AI development tools** to boost productivity and code quality.
* Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for **career advancement**
  

  

**About Zycus:**
Zycus, recognized by leading analyst firms in procurement technology, empowers teams to unlock deep value through its comprehensive Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) solutions. At the heart of our S2P solution is the Merlin Agentic Platform, which orchestrates intelligent AI agents to deliver simplified, efficient, and compliant processes.
The Merlin Intake Agent offers business users unparalleled ease of use, increasing adoption rates and significantly reducing non\-compliant spending. For procurement teams, the Merlin Autonomous Negotiation Agent handles tail spend autonomously, securing additional savings; the Merlin Contract Agent helps draft compliant contracts and reduces risks by actively monitoring them; and the Merlin AP Agent further enhances efficiency by automating invoice processing with exceptional speed and accuracy.

jobs.title: Mgr Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem


ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.


As a Mgr Software Engineering in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!  



Job Summary:


Manages the activities of one or more software systems development function or software applications development function. Selects, develops and evaluates personnel to ensure the efficient operation of the function.


Job Responsibilities:


* Manages and directs ACI's development resources in accordance with corporate and division goals and objectives. Instructs and guides staff to maximize their technical, managerial, and corporate growth and development. Provides feedback and completes performance appraisals. Develops annual staff salary, training plans, and reports on the status of the staff and projects.
* Works with senior management to set the technical direction for company products and services. Leads and guides the development and maintenance products and services ensuring that they align with the company’s strategic and business plans.
* Manages product security including product risk reduction, compliance, product security training, product security software development lifecycle, and security architecture.
* Leads interaction with internal and external organizations and individuals to ensure appropriate information exchange, with the goal of properly developing the staff and successfully completing assigned projects.
* Perform other duties as assigned
Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.  
* 

Key Responsibilities:


Engineering Leadership \& Delivery


* Lead and grow a cross\-functional team spanning backend, frontend, DevOps/Platform engineering, and Quality Engineering; drive strong ownership, execution discipline, and continuous improvement.
* Own delivery for roadmap initiatives and platform modernization across the full SDLC: planning, design, implementation, reviews, testing, release, and production operations.
Establish and communicate technical direction in partnership with Product Management and Architecture to ensure the platform meets business goals and non\-functional requirements.  
* 

Quality Engineering \& Test Automation (Shift\-Left)


* Build a “quality\-first” culture with an automated testing strategy across unit/integration/e2e, with strong coverage targets and non\-negotiable quality gates.
* Implement and operationalize modern test orchestration and automation tooling, including Testkube, and enforce reliable, maintainable CI test execution.
Drive security and compliance testing as part of CI/CD (SAST/DAST/dependency scanning), ensuring regulated\-workload readiness and auditability. ,  
* 

AI\-Enabled Engineering \& Delivered AI Projects (Must\-Have)


* Lead delivery of AI\-enabled initiatives in two dimensions:

	+ AI\-accelerated SDLC (planning, code review, test generation, documentation, defect reduction), and
	+ AI/ML/GenAI solution delivery where AI is part of the shipped product or operational capability.
* Establish responsible AI usage practices: teams are encouraged to use AI, but remain accountable for outputs; validate correctness, security, and maintainability before merging.
Enforce safe prompting and data handling: never place secrets/credentials/PCI/PII into prompts; use placeholders and abstractions.  
* 

People Leadership \& Stakeholder Management


* Coach engineers and QEs; build career plans, performance feedback loops, and hiring strategies to raise the talent bar.
Collaborate with Product, Security, Compliance, and Operations leaders to deliver outcomes with transparency, predictable execution, and clear metrics.  
* 

Knowledge, Skills and Experience required for the job:


* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience. 5 years software development and/or design experience.
Team and delivery Management or leadership experience.  
* 

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed for the job:


Prior experience in cards / payments / BFSI domain.  

* 

Work Environment:


* Standard in\-office work environment
Some limited Travel required, may be domestic or international  
* 

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.  



Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com  



\#LI\-AP


  
ACI Worldwide is a global leader in mission\-critical, real\-time payments software . Our proven, secure and scalable software solutions enable leading corporations, fintechs and financial disruptors to process and manage digital payments , power omni\-commerce payments , present and process bill payments , and manage fraud and risk . We combine our global footprint with a local presence to drive the real\-time digital transformation of payments and commerce.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Full Stack (.NET/React) (all genders)
jobs.description:

As part of our development team, you will be responsible for the further development of our enterprise software for marketing automation. With this solution, our more than 200 customers from a wide range of industries control their digital marketing campaigns at every touchpoint \- automated, individualized and intelligent based on AI.  

  

Employment is provided through an Employer of Record model via our partner Multiplier.

* Backend: C\# with .NET/ .NET Core

Software Engineer II
Overview  

The Software Engineer II is an experienced full\-stack software engineer specializing in modern JavaScript technologies, React\-based user interfaces, Node.js services, and distributed data platforms. This role independently develops scalable, secure, and cloud\-ready applications while contributing to software design, architecture, operational excellence, production support, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

* Apply secure coding practices and proactively address security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Conduct code reviews and contribute to engineering standards, quality initiatives, and knowledge sharing.
* Troubleshoot application, performance, database, and production issues using structured root cause analysis techniques.
* Monitor, maintain, and support applications in production environments with a focus on reliability and operational excellence.

* Collaborate with Product, UX, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams to deliver business capabilities.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous delivery activities.
* Research emerging technologies, frameworks, AI\-assisted development tools, and engineering practices to improve team productivity and product quality.

  

All About You  

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Hands\-on experience developing applications using React and modern frontend ecosystems.
* Experience building backend services and APIs using Node.js and Express.js or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design principles, and frontend performance optimisation.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating third\-party services.
* Solid understanding of relational databases including MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* Experience working with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
* Understanding of database design, indexing strategies, query optimisation, and data modelling.

* Experience or exposure to AI\-assisted development tools, AI\-powered applications, autonomous agents, or agentic workflows.

* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Role description**  

We are looking for senior, autonomous software engineers to build AI\-powered product features for a Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, AI systems, and scalable cloud architecture. You will design, build, and evolve AI\-based capabilities such as: Real\-time and post\-call transcription services LLM\- features (summarization, agent assist, analytics, automation) Prompt management and orchestration Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines Knowledge base ingestion and management AI\-driven workflows embedded directly into CCaaS user experiences You are expected to deeply understand product requirements, make technical decisions independently, and contribute end\-to\-end from architecture and backend services to frontend experiences. What You ll Do AI\-Centric Product Development Design and implement AI\-based product features for CCaaS use cases Integrate LLM services, transcription engines, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG pipelines Design prompt strategies, prompt versioning, and evaluation mechanisms for reliable AI behavior. Build systems that safely and efficiently interact with external AI providers (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS, etc.). Architecture \& Scalability Design scalable, modular, and observable AI architectures suitable for real\-time and high\-volume CCaaS workloads. Apply best practices for event\-driven, asynchronous, and distributed systems. Ensure AI systems are cost\-aware, fault\-tolerant, and designed for continuous evolution. Collaborate on decisions around data flow, latency, throughput, and reliability especially for real\-time voice and messaging scenarios. Full\-Stack Ownership Build and maintain backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and NestJS. Develop frontend experiences using React.js (or similar), especially for AI\-assisted workflows and real\-time UI updates. Contribute to API design, frontend\-backend contracts, and system integrations. For frontend\-leaning roles: focus on AI\-driven UX, real\-time dashboards, agent tools, and explainability of AI outputs. Product \& Team Collaboration Work closely with product managers, designers, QA, and other engineers from discovery to delivery. Translate business and product needs into clear technical designs and implementation plans. Actively challenge assumptions and propose better solutions technically and from a product perspective. Mentor peers and contribute to engineering best practices and standards. Engineering Excellence Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code. Build automated tests for business\-critical and AI\-dependent logic. Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions. Create and maintain technical documentation for both systems and AI behaviors. Continuously improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience. What You Bring Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 6 \- 8 years of professional software development experience. Strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and React.js (or equivalent frontend frameworks). Proven ability to work autonomously, owning features from concept to production. Solid understanding of loosely coupled, modular, and event\-driven architectures. Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered production features (not just experimentation). LLM concepts and limitations Prompt engineering and prompt lifecycle management RAG architectures and vector search Knowledge base ingestion and enrichment pipelines Experience integrating with AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or similar). Ability to reason about latency, accuracy, cost, and reliability trade\-offs in AI systems. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with cloud\-native architectures (AWS, Azure). Experience with message brokers / streaming platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka). Strong Git workflows and CI/CD best practices. Comfort working in Linux\-based environments. Mindset \& Soft Skills Product\-oriented mindset: you understand why you rebuilding something, not just how. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Excellent communication skills; comfortable working with distributed teams (fluent English required). Willingness to challenge ideas constructively and propose alternatives. Passion for learning, experimentation, and staying current with AI and software trends. Leadership mindset whether through mentoring, technical guidance, or ownership. Additional Requirements We Consider Essential Knowledge of VoIP, real\-time communications, or contact center platforms. Experience handling real\-time or near\-real\-time data streams. Understanding of observability for distributed and AI\-driven systems. Awareness of AI governance, security, and privacy considerations, especially when handling customer conversations and data. Strong bias toward simple, maintainable solutions over over\-engineering.
